scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas
other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents should reside in Andhra Pradesh

Student must be admitted to any master's degree course overseas of at least 12 months duration during the year 2019‑20, or be pursuing the final year of the PEC course overseas in collaboration with an Indian university/institute
Student who has already availed benefit under this scheme is not eligible
Student must not have received any amount from any other government scheme for the same purpose
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of up to ₹5,00,000 for overseas courses of 11‑18 months, and up to ₹10,00,000 for master’s degree programmes of at least 18 months abroad.
application_link: Registration Step-01: Applicants have to visit the official website and click on Scheme. Step-02: Click on "Registration" under the concerned scheme name. Step-03: Fill out the application form with required details like: Personal Details: Name, Residence address, Aadhaar no, Ration card no, Bank detail etc Upload: Photo, Signature and Certificate Details Documents: Birth Certificate, Residential Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate, Bank Passbook etc Finalize and "Submit" the application. Step-04: Receive the reference number after the submission. Check Application Status: Step-01: Click on the “Services” link on the menu and select "Know your status". Step-02: Enter the Reference or Mobile or Aadhaar Card Number to get the application status. Step-03: Select the "Financial Year" and Fetch the details. Download the Acknowledgement slip: Step-01: Applicants have to visit the official website and click on Scheme. Step-02: Click on the "Acknowledgement Slip" under the concerned scheme. Step-03: Enter the Aadhaar Card Number and select the "Scheme". Step-04: Click on the "Submit".
